newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down by 2.58 pct.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down by 2.58 pct.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed down by 2.58 percent largely driven by Arab Tunisian Bank which fell by 47 percent on its first day's dealing on the computerised system with its greater transparency, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 472.47 from 485.00 on Friday.
Volume was 1.08 million dinars against 2.28 million dinars. Most of the trade was on the bond's market with a turnover of 842,510 dinars, brokers said.
ATB bank dropped by 26.78 dinars to 30.12 dinars. Brokers linked the fall to the introduction of computerised dealing, with its greater transparency.

Since last October, the Tunis Stock Exchange has been gradually introducing computerised dealing for listed companies, with the system now 24 out of 31. Most of the computerised shares dropped sharply when they made the switch.
Banque de l'Habitat was down 3.21 dinars to 19.99 dinars. Banque de Tunisie eased 1.5 dinars to 72 dinars.
Placement de Tunisie fell 0.42 dinar to 14 dinars. Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel declined 0.31 dinar to 10.01 dinars.
Coke and beer bottler SFBT was up 0.94 dinar to 76.48 dinars. Retail stores MONOPRIX rose 0.9 dinar to 31.4 dinars. UBCI bank gained 0.7 dinar to 44.5 dinars. ($= 1.04 dinars)
